summary_of_pdf: This document is an RPost Registered Email receipt serving as verifiable evidentiary proof of delivery and opening for a 'FORMAL NOTICE OF LITIGATION HOLD AND PERSONAL LIABILITY.' The notice was transmitted by RJ Aguiar JR to recipients at RPost (oflores@rpost.com and lcardenas@rpost.com) on April 15, 2026, establishing a definitive timeline for the receipt of a demand to preserve evidence.
attorneys_comments: This receipt constitutes highly probative evidence of actual notice. From a tactical perspective, the RPost tracking data—specifically the 'Delivered and Opened' statuses coupled with HTTP-IP logging and UTC timestamps—provides a robust evidentiary foundation to defeat any subsequent claims of non-receipt or ignorance of the litigation hold by the adverse parties. Under the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, specifically FRCP 37(e), this document firmly triggers the recipients' affirmative duty to preserve Electronically Stored Information (ESI). Should the adverse parties fail to suspend their routine document destruction policies, this receipt will serve as prima facie evidence of intentional spoliation, thereby supporting severe sanctions, including adverse inference jury instructions. The explicit mention of 'PERSONAL LIABILITY' in the subject line further places the individual corporate officers or agents on notice of potential piercing of the corporate veil or direct tortious liability.
recommended_next_steps: 1.
